E.name: Spell Shield
E.title: Template:Data Sivir/Spell Shield
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Spell Shield|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Sivir
|skill        = E
|icon         = Spell Shield.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sivir}} briefly gains a {{tip|spell shield}}. 
|blurb2       = '''Sivir''' {{tip|heals}} herself and activates {{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}} if it blocks an ability.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, she {{tip|heals}} herself and activates ''{{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}}'' after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Heal|{{as|{{ap|60 to 80}}% AD}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|24 to 18}}
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* ''Spell Shield'' will heal and activate {{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}} if any effect is blocked. This includes effects such as [[champion ability|champion abilities]], [[Named item effect|item effects]], {{uis|Dragon}} basic attacks, as well as the abilities of {{ui|Baron Nashor}} and {{ui|Rift Herald}}.
* ''Spell Shield'' will still block abilities that have already been applied to '''Sivir''' if the delayed effects of that ability is [[area of effect]] (e.g. {{ai|Blaze 2|Brand|Blaze's}} explosion, {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}}, and {{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}}).
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Sivir_Original_EHit_1.ogg}} ''"Nice try."''
}}
